skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature and content of business strategy for commercial enterprises in the context of globalization.
Analyze internal and external factors affecting the formulation, selection, and implementation of business strategies.
Formulate and select business strategies based on analysis of industry, macroeconomic, and international environments.
Demonstrate independent work ability, personal responsibility, and responsibility towards group work.
Plan, coordinate, manage resources, evaluate, and improve the effectiveness of activities.
Apply business strategies to manage commercial enterprises and services.
Present and defend personal viewpoints based on objective and scientific approaches in planning, coordination, resource management, evaluation, and improvement of activities.
